ownership: Fresh work performed by a disclosed local desktop, standalone connector or automatic managed updater under its own host OS account's acknowledged policy. No persisted operational history or cross-user server work is exported.

desktop.update_download.retries: one cycle including verification and bounded retries

desktop.update_verify.scope: Windows/macOS validation attempts use explicit verifying through ready/error/cancelled events; macOS includes extraction. Linux requires fresh transfer progress and successful completion with the original attempt policy, without phase latency; cached readiness and opaque failures do not establish a validation outcome.

desktop.update_apply.success: accepted installer handoff only; installed version is unobserved

stage.scope: fresh staging including artifact verification; a reused ready runtime contributes nothing

verify.scope: final installed-package and runtime-wheel integrity checks in fresh staging; only the standalone automatic watcher owns them

apply.scope: the automatic updater remains alive to observe process readiness and completed cutover; recovered candidate failure is recorded only after rollback returns

rollback.scope: fresh rollback performed now, including by a new watcher; no backfilled interrupted apply result

resources.desktop_source_rss: Maximum supplied by this owned worker's live RSS callback; unavailable if the worker supplies no sample.
resources.desktop_source_budget: The selected worker's configured memory ceiling, only alongside an actual worker RSS sample.
resources.headless_source_rss: This standalone process's RSS at the end of its work; not a peak or whole-host total.
resources.headless_source_cpu: This standalone process's CPU-time difference over the observed work interval; not whole-host activity.
resources.headless_capture_budget: The standalone retained-capture process's configured memory ceiling.

exclusions.empty_scan: A successful scheduled scan with no changed/removed/conflicted or locally accepted/delivered items produces no product observation.
exclusions.desktop_requested_scan: An explicit Sync request already has its desktop/native-operator owner; the queued continuation contributes no second workflow.
exclusions.reusable_sync: Calling the reusable connector sync or capture helpers does not infer an owner.
exclusions.remote_or_managed_scan: Remote-requested scans and host-managed child processes do not inherit an administrator's telemetry choice.
exclusions.inspection_and_controls: Discovery, provider inspection, saved scan history and capture-control transport do not start a background observer. Explicit standalone controls use their own reviewed action boundary.
exclusions.control_inspection: Capture status and configuration previews do not identify a new work operation.
exclusions.control_secret: Generating or inspecting private keys is not product telemetry.
exclusions.control_nested: Only the standalone command owns a control. Reusable perform calls, managed/reporting children and remote-requested work do not inherit its choice.
exclusions.model_nested: Deployment/startup calls explicitly decline preparation ownership. Registry helpers and model-list inspection acquire no owner; model/profile names and output stay private.
exclusions.updater_poll: Scheduled current-version checks, progress messages and safe-restart readiness checks are not separate uses.
exclusions.updater_internal_stage: The download cycle retains its original outcome. Only observable validation attempts have a separate verify outcome; repeated progress events, polling and unobserved internal checks do not. Verification stages and download cycles are different units and must not be summed as unique user actions.
exclusions.updater_quit: Unfinished update observations are discarded on quit. No shutdown flush or inferred post-restart success.
exclusions.host_updater_unowned: Manual/API/library update calls do not acquire the standalone automatic watcher's owner or inherit a remote operator's telemetry choice.
exclusions.mixed_host: Shared service workers, their queues and host-wide CPU/RAM totals are not observed.
